finding.cause: Original request checks the pinned Root pidfd after receiving a complete response. Original exchange returns after writing it without a client-consumption acknowledgement. Immediate Root resource drop and process return can race that postcheck.

change: Root keeps the actual final peer and all actual returned joined owners until an EOF-only read of that same live peer. The new method consumes the stream slot once, reads exactly one byte using only owner.end, rejects any byte, and postchecks the original peer/end on EOF. It never starts a new frame or per-request deadline; it does not prove response consumption or C completion.
client_contract: Only after complete ACK2 decoding and all existing exact binding/purpose/sequence/digest, original deadline and pidfd postchecks, the client closes/shuts down its same actual final stream including retained aliases while the original daemon remains alive. It must not wait for Root exit first. Any error still closes the common Gate.
